g.text: K-502: recycle circulator, electric drive (D-016); UIC-1802 anti-surge on the suction flow
R-501: 3 adiabatic beds, interbed exchange inside the converter; TIC-1803 converter inlet by the E-501 bypass
AIC-1804: H2/N2 ratio of the converter feed, trims FIC-1201 (P-103); loop relief on V-501 (P-110)
